events.headline: Injective (INJ) Mainnet Stops Block Production for 4 Hours 24 Minutes
events.eventClass: chain halt (block production stopped 4h24m Nov 9-10; Upbit/Coinone/Kraken suspend INJ deposits/withdrawals) - rev3: blocks resumed after validator security patch; cause disputed
events.relevance: Rev3: production resumed ~02:29 Nov 10 after validators applied a security patch (per Figment); cause disputed (Foundation precaution vs planned upgrade test); no Foundation post-mortem; Upbit, Coinone and Kraken still suspending INJ transfers, spot trading open

events.headline: Valour launches eight new ETPs on Spotlight Stock Market including a Morpho (MORPHO) ETP
events.eventClass: ETP launch (Valour Morpho ETP, SEK, Spotlight Stock Market Sweden)
events.relevance: First listed ETP tracking MORPHO (SEK-denominated, Swedish Spotlight Stock Market); small regulated retail access channel; no AUM/flow data yet

events.headline: Upbit to list Hyperliquid (HYPE) across KRW, BTC and USDT trading pairs on Nov. 10
events.eventClass: exchange listing (Upbit KRW/BTC/USDT, trading from 15:00 KST Nov 10; Bithumb unconfirmed)
events.relevance: Actual spot listing on Upbit opens Korean KRW/BTC/USDT access to HYPE; Bithumb listing reported but not confirmed

events.headline: Canary Capital launches the first U.S. spot Staked INJ ETF (INJC) on Nasdaq
events.eventClass: ETF launch (Canary Staked INJ ETF, ticker INJC, trading on Nasdaq)
events.relevance: First U.S. spot INJ ETF, staking at least 90% of holdings; creates a regulated demand channel for INJ; no flow data yet

events.headline: Coinbase enables USDC borrowing against tokenized gold (PAXG) via a new Morpho market on Base
events.eventClass: counterparty integration (Coinbase Borrow adds PAXG/USDC market on Morpho)
events.relevance: Coinbase Borrow adds its first non-crypto collateral through a new Morpho market; more flow on Morpho, no MORPHO token-economics change stated

events.headline: Binance reopens withdrawals in phases (BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, BNB, XRP) as ~95% of $6.3B hack losses are replaced
events.eventClass: exchange hack - resolution (withdrawals reopened in phases Nov 1; ~95% of $6.3B replaced)
events.relevance: Rev4: withdrawals resumed Nov 1; replenishment ~95%; further phases pending per-chain checks. Lowers exchange-insolvency-tail risk for BNB holders

events.headline: THORChain pauses operations after Ethereum reorg triggers double refund
events.eventClass: swap pause / outage (emergency pause after Ethereum reorg caused a duplicate 10 ETH refund)
events.relevance: THORChain halted swaps across most supported chains; no resumption reported and no official statement found
